# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 63 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 63

**1** Jesus said: "There was a wealthy man with vast resources. He told himself: 'I'll put my money to work — I'll sow and reap and plant and fill up my storerooms — so that I'll never go without.' That was the plan he was turning over in his mind. But that same night, he died. Anyone with ears to hear, listen."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Vast resources" — conveys the excess beyond mere wealth
- "Told himself" — makes the interior monologue explicit
- "Put my money to work" — contemporary idiom for investment/deployment of capital
- "Turning over in his mind" — vivid rendering of "thinking in his heart"
- Thomas's stark ending (no divine commentary) preserved
